# SK1025 — Freeze a private lookup-only dictionary

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

A private static readonly Dictionary with constant entries is used only for lookups.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Modernization |
| Default severity | hint |
| Scope | Semantic |
| Needs a compilation | yes |
| Fix | yes, safe |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 1.3 |

## Why

FrozenDictionary optimizes immutable lookup tables. The fix retains the original Dictionary construction and its duplicate-key checks, then freezes it. Every source reference must remain compatible with read-only lookup semantics.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
static readonly System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, int> Codes = new() { { "ok", 200 } };
```

Write:

```csharp
static readonly System.Collections.Frozen.FrozenDictionary<string, int> Codes = System.Collections.Frozen.FrozenDictionary.ToFrozenDictionary(new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, int>() { { "ok", 200 } });
```

## When it does not fire

Only private static readonly fields in non-partial classes, constructed with the parameterless framework Dictionary constructor and constant key/value collection entries, are supported. Keys must be non-nullable integral/char or string; nullable value annotations are preserved. All uses must be indexer reads, Count, ContainsKey or TryGetValue. Mutation, enumeration, Keys/Values, aliases, escapes, custom comparers, nonconstant entries, other-file constants, directives, field comments/attributes and expression trees are excluded. Requires the framework FrozenDictionary factory. Startup work increases and runtime gains require measurement. Reflection and private-field serialization are outside the proof.

## Configuration

- `dotnet_diagnostic.SK1025.severity`
